x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: CLI tool for the Sonauto SDK.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --api-key
options.description: API key. Falls back to configured environment variables, dotnet user-secrets, and the optional credential file.

options.name: --base-url
options.description: Override the API base URL.

options.name: --json
options.description: Render structured responses as raw JSON instead of human-readable text. [default: False]

options.name: --output
options.description: Write response content to this file path instead of stdout.

options.name: --output-dir
options.description: Write one file per returned item when the response contains multiple resources.

commands.name: auth
commands.description: Inspect and manage API credentials used by the generated CLI.

commands.name: set
commands.description: Store an API key in dotnet user-secrets.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show the authentication source order the CLI will use.

commands.name: clear
commands.description: Clear the API key stored in dotnet user-secrets.

commands.name: get-credits-balance
commands.description:
Get credit balance
Returns remaining subscription credits and pay-as-you-go credits.

commands.name: extend-v2
commands.description:
Extend an existing song (v2)
Continues an existing audio clip by generating before or after it.

options.name: --instrumental
options.description: Specify true/false; presence alone implies true; omit to inherit.

options.name: --align-lyrics
options.description: Specify true/false; presence alone implies true; omit to inherit.

options.name: --audio-url
options.description: URL of the source audio. Either this or audio_base64 is required.

options.name: --audio-base64
options.description: Base64-encoded source audio. Either this or audio_url is required.

options.name: --side
options.description: Which side of the source audio to extend.

options.name: --extend-duration
options.description: How many seconds to generate on the chosen side.

options.name: --crop-duration
options.description: Seconds of source audio to drop from the chosen side before extending.

options.name: --input
options.description: Load request JSON from a file path, '-' for stdin, or an inline JSON object/array string.

options.name: --request-json
options.description: Request body as JSON.

options.name: --request-file
options.description: Path to a JSON request file, or '-' for stdin.

commands.name: generate-v2
commands.description:
Generate a song (Melodia v2)
Kicks off a v2 generation task. v2 does not stream but supports `num_songs`,
`balance_strength`, `seed`, and BPM control.

options.name: --instrumental
options.description: Specify true/false; presence alone implies true; omit to inherit.

options.name: --seed
options.description: Deterministic seed.

options.name: --num-songs
options.description: Number of song variations to generate (v2 only).

options.name: --align-lyrics
options.description: Specify true/false; presence alone implies true; omit to inherit.

options.name: --bpm
options.description: Target BPM; use the string "auto" or an integer.

options.name: --input
options.description: Load request JSON from a file path, '-' for stdin, or an inline JSON object/array string.

options.name: --request-json
options.description: Request body as JSON.

options.name: --request-file
options.description: Path to a JSON request file, or '-' for stdin.

commands.name: generate-v3
commands.description:
Generate a song (Melodia v3, streaming-capable)
Kicks off a v3 generation task. v3 supports streaming playback via the
separate streaming endpoint when `enable_streaming` is `true`.

options.name: --tags
options.description: Style descriptors (e.g. "rock", "uplifting"). Optional but recommended.

options.name: --lyrics
options.description: Song lyrics. Use `[verse]`, `[chorus]`, and other markers for structure.

options.name: --prompt
options.description: Natural language description of the desired song.

options.name: --instrumental
options.description: Generate an instrumental (no vocals). Specify true/false; presence alone implies true; omit to inherit.

options.name: --prompt-strength
options.description: How closely the model should follow the prompt. Higher = stricter.

options.name: --webhook-url
options.description: URL to POST the result to when the task completes.

options.name: --output-format
options.description: Output audio format (ogg, mp3, flac, wav, m4a).

options.name: --output-bit-rate
options.description: Optional bit rate for the output file.

options.name: --enable-streaming
options.description: When true, the song can be streamed while still generating. Specify true/false; presence alone implies true; omit to inherit.

options.name: --stream-format
options.description: Audio format used for streaming playback.

options.name: --align-lyrics
options.description: Include time-aligned lyrics in the result. Specify true/false; presence alone implies true; omit to inherit.

options.name: --input
options.description: Load request JSON from a file path, '-' for stdin, or an inline JSON object/array string.

options.name: --request-json
options.description: Request body as JSON.

options.name: --request-file
options.description: Path to a JSON request file, or '-' for stdin.

commands.name: get-generation
commands.description:
Get a completed generation
Retrieves the full generation result, including song URLs, lyrics, and tags.

arguments.name: TASK_ID
arguments.description: The task identifier returned by a generation request.

commands.name: get-generation-status
commands.description:
Get generation status
Returns the current status (e.g. PENDING, RUNNING, SUCCESS, FAILURE) for a task.

options.name: --include-alignment
options.description: When true, response also includes the lyrics `alignment_status`. Specify true/false; presence alone implies true; omit to inherit.

arguments.name: TASK_ID
arguments.description: The task identifier returned by a generation request.
